subject.title: fix(ui): preserve agent, session, locale, and dashboard ownership

question: Once the currently running exact-head checks complete, should this deliberately grouped set of five Control UI ownership fixes land together rather than be split into separate PRs?
rationale: The patch spans several independent user-visible ownership paths, but the supplied discussion says their boundaries were intentionally kept with their existing owners and the unrelated browser-operation work was isolated. A maintainer should confirm that grouping remains the desired landing unit after fresh CI.

options.title: Accept the grouped repair
options.body: Merge the five bounded fixes together after the remaining checks pass on the current head, preserving the separate browser-operation follow-up.

options.title: Request narrower PRs
options.body: Ask for a split only if maintainers prefer independent landing and rollback units over the shared ownership-proof context.

recommendation.body: Merge the five bounded fixes together after the remaining checks pass on the current head, preserving the separate browser-operation follow-up.
